subject.title: [Feature]:Add configUrl and configButton support in SKILL.md frontmatter

question: Should `SKILL.md` expose dashboard configuration actions, and what URL/action trust contract should those actions use?
rationale: The implementation shape is clear, but the permanent public metadata semantics and clickable URL security boundary are product/security choices that automation should not decide.

options.title: Add typed config action
options.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust UI, docs, and tests before implementation.

options.title: Reuse homepage only
options.body: Keep the existing `homepage` field as the only skill-authored link and avoid a separate dashboard configuration action for now.

options.title: Defer to ClawHub or Skill Card
options.body: Require skills to expose richer setup/configuration through ClawHub or Skill Card metadata instead of adding new core frontmatter fields.

recommendation.title: Add typed config action
recommendation.body: Define a typed `metadata.openclaw` configuration action with explicit URL validation, trust UI, docs, and tests before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans public docs, core/plugin boundaries, and UI URL trust policy, and recent history shows adjacent ownership in those areas.
